Dear Celonis Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my enthusiastic interest in the Chief Of Staff position at Celonis.

My career has centered on operational excellence, business process optimization, and enterprise transformation. Having scaled industrial manufacturing and deep-tech platforms while driving a 40% efficiency increase at Vega Aviation through autonomous AI workflows, I intimately understand how data-driven process intelligence transforms enterprise bottom lines. I am eager to partner with Celonis leadership to accelerate operational rhythm and strategic initiatives.

KEY STRATEGIC HIGHLIGHTS:
• Chief of Staff & AI Strategist (Vega Aviation): Deployed enterprise multi-agent AI systems, boosting operational efficiency by 40% and achieving aviation certifications 3 months ahead of schedule.
• Founder & Managing Director (HeatBolt / Parshwa Power): Commercialized breakthrough thermal engineering platforms; forged institutional partnerships across FMCG, Aviation Catering, and Defence Forces.
• Strategic Advisor to CEOs & Board Chairs: Guided executive decision-making across regulated aviation, green hydrogen (advanced research at IISc Bangalore), energy, and enterprise technology.
• Agile & Remote Leadership: Extensive experience driving high-velocity distributed teams with clear OKRs, transparent communication, and rigorous accountability.

I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my strategic leadership and execution track record can drive measurable impact for Celonis.

Warm regards,

Dr. Kumarpal Porwal
